title: Smooth Doom
description: Smooth Doom is a visual gameplay mod by Gifty that enhances and extends the animations of Doom and Doom II's monsters, weapons, items, and decorations. By adding extra sprite frames and visual effects, it makes motion appear more fluid without changing gameplay. The mod also introduces dynamic lights, unique blood colors, new sounds, and optional toggles like weapon recoil and particle effects.
